description: This file provides authentication-related services such as user registration, login, and OTP verification. It interacts with database repositories and security modules, managing user tokens and credentials.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] register_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, user_type: str, full_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Registers a new user by generating a UUID, invoking the user creation repository, and creating an access token.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] login_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Logs in a user by retrieving user data, then issuing an access token. Skips password verification, assuming external auth.

methods.name: bool verify_otp(_: Session, email: str, otp: str)
methods.description: Stub function for OTP verification, always returns True. Placeholder for integrating with Supabase OTP endpoints.
